title: Registry gate accepted fetch aliases through nested Window and Document.defaultView proxies

redReproductions.observed: Gate passed before the Window-proxy fix.
Gate still passed after the first fix; frames was not yet resolved as a Window proxy.
Gate still passed after Window-proxy aliases were added; Document.defaultView was not yet resolved as a Window.

remediation: Resolve nested Window proxy members (window, frames, opener, parent, self, top) and Document.defaultView before applying existing network-sink detection, including statically aliased forms.

validation.focusedRegression: 2 tests passed; 10 Window/Document proxy access forms rejected by the checker and the representative source rejected by the complete contribution gate.
validation.resourceIsolation: 324/324 canonical resources passed; 0 symlinks skipped; 0 failures.
validation.auditAll: passed all 16 behavioral gates, catalogue build, 718-page Astro production build, Sites Worker build, bundle budgets, provenance, secret/security, and dependency audits.

browserSemanticsProbe.result: window === window.frames; window.fetch and document.defaultView.fetch are functions; Window.prototype.fetch is undefined in the tested Chromium context.
browserSemanticsProbe.scope: Trusted browser property inspection only; no untrusted resource source was executed and no network request was sent.

deployment: not deployed; release-candidate verification remains open
